impact: 412 merchants saw checkout errors for 78 minutes. 1,940 orders failed and were retried.
stated_cause: Schema migrations acquire table locks with no timeout, so any long migration can stall the write path indefinitely.
contributing_factors: The migration tooling has no default lock timeout, so a slow migration blocks writes rather than aborting.
The rollback initially ran against the wrong replica, extending the outage by roughly 20 minutes.
Write-path saturation had no alert, so detection came from a merchant report rather than monitoring.
narrative: Rae Lindqvist was paged at 09:12 after a merchant report. Sam Okafor identified the held lock at 09:31 and rolled the migration back at 09:48.

action_items.title: Set a default lock timeout of 5s on all migrations
Alert on write-path saturation above 80% for 2 minutes
Add replica identity to the rollback runbook
Post the incident summary to the status page
